SQL.code:
SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) AS total
FROM orders o
JOIN departments d ON d.id = o.dept_id
WHERE o.created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7
GROUP BY d.name
ORDER BY total DESC;

Oracle.code:

FROM readings
WHERE reading_date >= :from_date
ORDER BY reading_date DESC
FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY;
